name: com.evolc/signals
title: Evolc Signals
description: Search companies by fit, hiring and recent events with date windows, exclusions and evidence.

tools.name: search_signals
tools.description: Find companies in Europe and the Americas (US, CA, BR, MX) with fresh buying signals: started hiring in a function (e.g. first SDRs), hiring spikes, leadership roles, funding, acquisitions, product launches, expansions, partnerships, milestones, layoffs, revenue jumps, turning profitable, director changes and news. Data comes from company careers pages, ATS job boards, news feeds and public business registers, deepest in Slovakia, Czechia, Poland, Hungary, Austria and Germany. Filters combine with AND; values inside one filter with OR. Use employee_bands, business_models, HQ and office filters for company fit; job_countries, job_city, job_skill and min_new_roles to target openings; contract_buyer and contract_min_eur for SK/CZ public contracts. Use signal_rules for All, Any and Exclude with a window per rule. Returns ranked companies with dated evidence. Company facts only, no people.

countries.description: ISO-2 country codes of the company (SK Slovakia, CZ Czechia, PL Poland, HU Hungary, AT Austria, SI Slovenia, DE Germany, CH Switzerland, HR Croatia, RO Romania, GB United Kingdom, IE Ireland, FR France, BE Belgium, NL Netherlands, LU Luxembourg, ES Spain, PT Portugal, IT Italy, MT Malta, GR Greece, CY Cyprus, DK Denmark, SE Sweden, NO Norway, FI Finland, IS Iceland, EE Estonia, LV Latvia, LT Lithuania, BG Bulgaria, RS Serbia, BA Bosnia and Herzegovina, ME Montenegro, MK North Macedonia, AL Albania, UA Ukraine, MD Moldova, LI Liechtenstein, MC Monaco, AD Andorra, SM San Marino, US United States, CA Canada, BR Brazil, MX Mexico).

families.description: Hiring for these job functions. With only event kinds (e.g. funding) the company must also have an open role in one of these functions.

subs.description: Sub-roles within the chosen families, e.g. sales → sdr_bdr. By family: engineering: backend, frontend, fullstack, mobile, devops_sre, qa, embedded, security, architect, engineering_management; data: data_engineering, data_science, ml_ai, analytics_bi; product: product_management, product_owner, project_management; design: product_design, ux_research, graphic_brand; robotics: robot_programming, plc_controls, mechatronics, robotics_software; manufacturing: cnc_machining, production, maintenance, quality, process_engineering, mechanical_design, welding_fabrication; sales: account_executive, sdr_bdr, sales_management, partnerships, presales_solutions; marketing: growth, content, performance, product_marketing, brand_pr, marketing_management; customer: customer_success, support, account_management, implementation; operations: operations, supply_chain_logistics, office_admin, business_ops; finance: accounting, fp_and_a, controlling; people: recruiting, hr, people_ops; legal: legal, compliance; executive: c_level, general_management; other: .

kinds.description: Signal kinds that qualify a company (default: all). hiring = new roles in the window; first_in_function = first role in that function since we began tracking the company (at least 14 days earlier; job history starts 2026-10-16); hiring_spike = 3+ new roles in one function; leadership_role_open = head/director/VP/C-level role opened; revenue_jump and profitability_flip come from registry filings; funding, acquisition, launch, expansion, partnership, milestone and layoffs are moves read from the news; contract_won = signed a public-sector contract as supplier (SK/CZ registers, ≥ €10k); content_push = started or restarted publishing; tender_won = linked public award notice (EU TED, UK Find a Tender); technology_detected = new website technology observed; new_country = first observed role outside HQ country; grant_signed = signed Horizon Europe grant agreement for a linked Slovak or Czech business.

q.description: Company name, website or one-liner contains this text.

since.description: Only signals newer than this ISO date or timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-01.

exclude_volume.description: Leave out volume hirers (staffing agencies, branch and field-sales networks, brokers, fundraisers). Set false to include them; they carry volume_hiring: true.

offset.description: Skip this many companies (use `next` from the previous answer).

employee_bands.description: Employee bands. Use unknown to include companies without an employee band.

office_countries.description: Countries with a known office, including headquarters. ISO-2.

founded_from.description: Founded in this year or later.

founded_to.description: Founded in this year or earlier.

tech.description: Exact name of a detected website technology.

profitability.description: Profitability based on the latest filings available.

job_countries.description: Countries of qualifying new open roles. ISO-2.

job_city.description: Exact city of a qualifying new open role.

job_skill.description: Exact skill normalized from a qualifying new open role.

min_new_roles.description: Minimum new open roles within the main window and matching all job filters.

min_open_jobs.description: Minimum current open jobs across the company.

tech_change.description: Exact technology name or ID newly observed on a website. Requires a dated technology observation.

tender_cpv.description: CPV category prefix (2 to 8 digits) of a linked public award notice (EU TED or UK Find a Tender).

grant_topic.description: Text in a signed Horizon Europe project title, topic codes or keywords. Pilot coverage is Slovakia and Czechia.

grant_min_eur.description: Minimum company-level net EU contribution in a signed Horizon Europe grant agreement. Pilot coverage is Slovakia and Czechia.

contract_buyer.description: Buyer name contains this text on a qualifying SK/CZ signed public contract.

contract_min_eur.description: Minimum value of a qualifying SK/CZ signed public contract in EUR (CZK converted at a fixed reference rate).

signal_rules.description: Up to four signal rules in mode:kind:days format, e.g. all:funding:90, any:expansion:30, exclude:layoffs:90. All rules are required, Any rules form one OR group, and Exclude rules reject matching companies. The days must be 7, 30 or 90.

sort.description: Rank by signal strength (default) or latest matching signal.

preview.description: Show the interpreted filters before running the search. Uses no search quota.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Public Evolc profile of one company by its Evolc slug or its website domain: description, industry, size, founded year, open jobs, highlights with evidence, filed financials (newest first), public-sector customers and suppliers from the SK/CZ contract registers, and sources. No people or contact details.

slug.description: Evolc company slug, e.g. "acme" from companies.evolc.com/company/acme.

domain.description: Company website domain or URL, e.g. "acme.sk".

tools.name: check_accounts
tools.description: Check a list of known companies (e.g. the user's CRM accounts or target list, up to 100 per call): which are hiring, raised money or grew in the window, and which are quiet. Matching is exact by domain (website URL or e-mail address at the company also works), else by name within a country, else by a unique name; name matches are marked. The list is used only to answer this call.

accounts.description: Companies to check, each with a domain or a name.

domain.description: Website domain, URL or an e-mail address at the company.

country.description: ISO-2 country code; narrows name matching.

ref.description: Your id for this account, echoed back.

families.description: Only signals and open roles in these job functions.

exclude_volume.description: Leave out volume hirers (staffing agencies, branch and field-sales networks).

tools.name: search_moves
tools.description: The moves feed: what companies just did, worldwide (Europe first, US tech press since 2026-11-08), newest first — raised money, bought or merged (both sides when known), launched a product, entered a market or won a major customer, announced a partnership, stated a milestone (ARR, customers, IPO) or cut staff. Read from startup and business news feeds across Europe and US tech press, classified automatically; every move carries the article URL, a one-line English headline, the company slug and its open roles. Company facts only; executive hires are not listed.

countries.description: ISO-2 country codes of the company HQ, e.g. ["DE", "US"] (default: every country).

kinds.description: Kinds of move (default: all): funding = raised money; acquisition = bought, merged or sold a stake; launch = launched a product or service; expansion = entered a market, opened a site or won a major customer; partnership = announced a partnership; milestone = passed a stated milestone; layoffs = cut staff.

q.description: Company name or headline contains this text.

offset.description: Skip this many moves (for the next page).

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Open calls for tenders from public buyers across Europe (TED, the EU tenders journal), closing soonest first. Each tender has the buyer, category (CPV), estimated value, deadline and fit_count: how many Evolc companies won public tenders in the same CPV class since 2024. Pass company (an Evolc slug) to get the open tenders in the categories that company already wins, or filter by country, CPV division and text. Titles are in the buyer's language. The tender page (url) links to where offers are submitted.

company.description: Evolc company slug: return open tenders in the CPV classes this company won before (other filters are ignored).

divisions.description: CPV divisions (first two digits): 14 Mining & basic metals; 15 Food & beverages; 16 Agricultural machinery; 18 Clothing, footwear & accessories; 19 Leather, textiles, plastic & rubber; 22 Printed matter; 24 Chemical products; 30 Office & computer equipment; 31 Electrical equipment & lighting; 32 Telecom & radio equipment; 33 Medical equipment & pharmaceuticals; 34 Vehicles & transport equipment; 35 Security, fire & defence equipment; 37 Sports goods, toys & instruments; 38 Laboratory & precision equipment; 39 Furniture & cleaning products; 41 Water; 42 Industrial machinery; 43 Mining & construction machinery; 44 Construction materials; 45 Construction work; 48 Software & information systems; 50 Repair & maintenance; 51 Installation services; 55 Hotels, catering & retail; 60 Transport services; 63 Transport support & travel; 64 Postal & telecom services; 65 Public utilities; 66 Financial & insurance services; 70 Real estate services; 71 Architecture & engineering; 72 IT services & software development; 73 Research & development; 75 Public administration services; 76 Oil & gas services; 77 Agricultural & forestry services; 79 Business services: legal, marketing, consulting; 80 Education & training; 85 Health & social work; 90 Waste, cleaning & environmental services; 92 Recreation, culture & sport; 98 Other community services; 03 Agriculture, farming & forestry products; 09 Fuel, energy & electricity.

q.description: Title, buyer or category contains this text (titles are in the local language).

fit.description: Only tenders where at least one Evolc company won similar work.

tools.name: find_customers_for
tools.description: Give a company website and get the companies in Europe and the Americas most likely to buy from it that changed recently (hiring in the team that buys, a new leader, funding, better numbers), each with the fit reason, an opening line and the evidence links, plus a read-only link to the live list that can be forwarded to that company. Evolc reads the website first; the first call for a new site answers "analysing" (free) and the same call about two minutes later returns the list. The analysis is kept in your account and reused.

countries.description: Up to 12 ISO-2 codes to rank first (one code also filters the list).

goal.description: Optional: what kind of customers to look for, in a sentence.

limit.description: Accounts to return (default and cap depend on the plan: 5 on work, 25 on paid).

tools.name: list_saved_searches
tools.description: Lists saved Signals searches for the connected account, including their filters, cadence, alert state, and Evolc link.
